SO 66.title: Special Orders 66
SO 66.label: Sent home
SO 66.summary: 153rd FA Bn men transferred to the 70th Infantry Division for return to the United States. Authority: XXIII Corps and the 32nd Field Artillery Brigade.

SO 226.title: Special Orders 226
SO 226.label: Sent in
SO 226.summary: 29th Infantry Division men released from their units and assigned to the 153rd FA Bn. Authority: Seventh US Army. Where SO 66 sent the high-point men home, this order replaced them with low-point men who had to stay.
